name: gpt-audio-plugin
description: Create music from the current ChatGPT conversation and optional reference audio through Replicate.

interface.shortDescription: Turn ChatGPT context and reference audio into generated music.
interface.longDescription: Use the current conversation as creative direction, optionally add a recorded or uploaded reference clip, and generate music through your own Replicate account.
defaultPrompt: Open GPT Audio Plugin using the current conversation as the creative context.
Use our discussion so far as direction for a new piece of music.
